patch_description: Split the reverse CRZ chain into two shared parameters to increase entangling-angle expressivity while maintaining parameter efficiency. The odd-indexed reverse connections (7→6, 5→4, 3→2, 1→0) use parameter "crz_rev_a", and even-indexed connections (6→5, 4→3, 2→1) use parameter "crz_rev_b". This leverages the success of the current single-parameter design while adding structured variety to probe richer quantum correlations. The cost is minimal (+1 parameter), and the symmetry breaking should improve learning capacity.
